# Purpose
This file defines the `FD_METRICS_SEND` metadata table for the send path. It is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, so it lists metric names, metric kinds, and enum labels in a fixed order, and it must not be edited by hand. The table includes counters, gauges, and histogram metrics for send operations, QUIC connection states, packet handling, frame handling, and ACK processing. Other code can use `FD_METRICS_SEND` and `FD_METRICS_SEND_TOTAL` to register, index, or report these metrics at run time.
